result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers pick B clearly, tie the choice to chasing late loads on a 27-inch screen, and suggest the same slim, clickable summary strip in place of the KPI tiles. Answer B goes further on all-day use: it warns that a table sorted by lateness will reshuffle as ETAs update, and it names two cases where A would win (geographic work and a supervisor wall display). It also gives a concrete way to decide by watching dispatchers. Answer A is just as decisive but slightly longer, and its 'Not checked' section adds hedging without adding much insight. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers pick B and tie the choice to lateness triage, all-day use and the 27-inch screen. Both admit B is weaker on overview and on the map, and both suggest a slim summary strip and a docked map panel. Answer A is a little tighter and adds a sharp point about rows reshuffling during live updates. Answer B adds a useful point about spotting clusters of problems, but its hedging and 'Not checked' section make it longer and less decisive.
